opening.argument: The title presents Forsage as a fast-growing business and tells viewers to contact the promoter, while the description directly invites viewers to join a network-marketing business. Together, those statements promote entry into a named opportunity rather than merely discussing it. A separate SEC complaint describes the Forsage program as selling slots in a recruitment-dependent matrix, which supplies the basis for understanding the opportunity's structure. The detailed payout structure comes from that external case record, not from the short video itself, but the invitation to join and the contact solicitation are explicit. The description reinforces that invitation by calling it a fastest-growing business of the 21st century.
